definitions.explanation: Vinegar that has been blended with other seasonings such as sugar, salt, soy sauce, or dashi. Used as a base for various Japanese dishes including sushi rice, vinegared dishes (sunomono), and dressings.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}わせ{酢|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧おく。
examples.english: Prepare the seasoned vinegar in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合|あ}わせ{酢|ず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Pour seasoned vinegar over the vinegared dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}{酢|ず}→寿司酢：24484_sushizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜた→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧{合|あ}わせ{酢|ず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一種|いっしゅ}→一種：01628_isshu⟧だ。
examples.english: Sushi vinegar is a type of seasoned vinegar made by mixing vinegar with sugar and salt.

notes:
USAGE:
A cooking term. {合|あ}わせ means "combined" and {酢|ず} (voiced form of ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧) means "vinegar." The voicing of す to ず occurs in compound words ({連濁|れんだく}). There are many varieties depending on the dish: {二杯酢|にはいず} (vinegar + soy sauce), {三杯酢|さんばいず} (vinegar + soy sauce + mirin), ⟦{寿司酢|すしず}→寿司酢：24484_sushizu⟧ (sushi vinegar), etc.

TYPES:
- {二杯酢|にはいず}: two-part vinegar (vinegar + soy sauce)
- {三杯酢|さんばいず}: three-part vinegar (vinegar + soy sauce + mirin)
- ⟦{寿司酢|すしず}→寿司酢：24484_sushizu⟧: sushi vinegar (vinegar + sugar + salt)
- ⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧: sweet vinegar
